According to the Nallastians, these [power] gems should allow us to pass though the spaceport's defensive shields."<br />"They will work."<br />"Of course.|Jedi Master Mace Windu and the Skull Queen, the [[Margravine]] Quenelle, introduce the powerful Stars of Nallastia to Republic cruiser Captain Nico Medina|<ref name="SWA3">''[[Star Wars Adventures 3: The Hostage Princess]]''</ref>}}
'''Nico Medina''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of a [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|Republic cruiser]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. A [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[23 BBY/Legends|before]] the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he escorted [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] to the [[Fondor system/Legends|Fondor system]], where they provided backup reinforcement to a [[Mission to Fondor (Separatist Crisis)|mission]] headed by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]].<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner">''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]''</ref><ref name="Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls">''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]''</ref><ref name="SWA3" />

==Biography==
In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], Medina piloted a [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor's]] [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]]-[[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nallastia]], in an effort to liberate the [[Fondorian]]s from the machinations of [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], who sought, in a bid to seize more [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-manufacturing business for himself, to destroy the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]] and the [[Fondor Spaceport]] and surface factories.<ref name="SWA3" />

After Captain Medina was instructed by Mace Windu to ready his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] for liftoff, when the Jedi's duties were completed at the [[Skull Queen's fortress]], he promptly obeyed the order. Master Windu introduced Medina to the [[Lost Stars of Nallastia|Stars of Nallastia]], powerful [[Force field/Legends|energy-field]] dissipating gems that they would use to break through Fondor's [[Deflector shield/Legends|defensive shields]] that had been activated by Groodo's [[Droid Control Army]]. Medina seemed to take this almost [[Magic/Legends|magical]] solution in stride, for he'd heard of stranger things in his career. The crew was to take the vessel directly to the Fondor Spaceport, which was to be liberated from Groodo's grasp.<ref name="SWA3" />

===Venrap attack===
But as the cruiser took off from the fortress landing field, Medina and his [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilots]] were suddenly attacked by a [[venrap]] [[Snake/Legends|snake]] native to the surrounding jungles, causing the ship to lurch to one side and begin a nosedive to the moon's surface. The vicious purple-skinned, sharp-fanged creature coiled itself tightly around all three seated pilots, intending to crush the life out of them or perhaps kill them with its [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] venom. Rendered unconscious, the pilots slumped forward in their seats after Master Windu and the [[Skull Queen]], [[Quenelle]], rushed forward to seize control of the ship again and [[Death|kill]] the creature. The Skull Queen dealt the killing blow with her [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]], striking the serpent between the eyes. The snake's lifeless body flopped to the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] floor and slid back down the corridor and into the lounge.<ref name="SWA3" />

Captain Medina and his crew maintained stable condition and were soon recovered from the unnerving encounter.<ref name="SWA3" />
